messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Observed tail latency spikes on TP=2 fused-attn path when KV cache sharding is enabled. Repro on staging with long seqs (~1500-2048). Profiling shows an extra allgather per step causing tail latency.
Ajay Singh: Can you paste the profiler flame / a tiny perf summary? sounds like qkv allgather/serialize is the culprit.
Maria Gonzalez: profiler snippet I grabbed: 
```
# nvprof-ish summary (per-step median)
Time(ms)  Kernel
120       flash_attn_fwd
32        qkv_allgather
28        qkv_scatter
20        misc (memcpy, sync)
-- total step ~200ms --
```
Maria Gonzalez: qkv_allgather is ~32ms and seems to scale with batch size; when kvcache_shard > 1 we get this repeated at each iteration.
Selene Wu: Is this only when TP is using interleaved tensor parallel layout? We changed interleave grouping last week (commit 6f3a2b).
Maria Gonzalez: yes — switching TP layout to non-interleaved removes the repeated allgather and tail goes away.
perf-bot: perf trace uploaded: https://perf/reports/1839123456 — allgather latency increases sharply once seq_len > 1024; correlates with kvcache hit ratio.
Ajay Singh: My suspicion: kernel selector tries to pick flash_attn path assuming contiguous QKV memory. After we shard kvcache we do scatter/gather, which falls back to a qkv_allgather-based path and we pay both flash_attn work + collectives.
Ajay Singh: Current selector heuristic (simplified):
```
if seq_len <= 1024 and tp_layout == interleaved:
  kernel = flash_attn_v2
else:
  kernel = qkv_allgather_path
```
Ajay Singh: That is too coarse — it ignores `kvcache_sharded` and per-request batch/seq distribution.
Selene Wu: Agreed. We should add conditions: `if kvcache_sharded then do not combine flash_attn + remote qkv_scatter` or prefer a path that avoids duplicate collectives. Also track `kv_shard_count` in the selector.
Maria Gonzalez: Repro command I used on staging: 
```
python infra/bench/attn_micro.py --model=gpt-small --tp=2 --seq=2048 --batch=4 --kvcache-shard=2
```
devops-bot: Can repro on staging pinned to 6f3a2b. Rolling the affected canary off to reduce customer impact.
Ajay Singh: Short-term workaround: export KVCACHE_MODE=local to force local KV cache (avoids remote allgathers). Memory tradeoff but mitigates latency.
Selene Wu: I'll open a small PR to tighten the selector: check `if kvcache_sharded || kv_shard_count > 1 then kernel = scatter-first-path` and record `allgather_bytes` + `allgather_wall_ms` in traces.
Maria Gonzalez: Please also add a perf test that runs interleaved TP + kvcache_shard combos so we don't regress. I can run the A/B on staging after the PR drops.
Selene Wu: Will do — target PR today, add unit test that simulates scattered QKV layout + synthetic trace to ensure we don't pick a double-collective combo.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks, also +1 on adding a safety assert in kernel selector so we don't schedule flash_attn if it will cause an extra cross-node allgather.
Ajay Singh: I'll prototype a lightweight metric emitter for per-request `allgather_bytes` so we can alert on sudden jumps.
Maria Gonzalez: awesome — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
